VF-OUTGOING.NAME: OutgoingTranslationRUtoEN
VF-OUTGOING.scenario: User speaks Russian into Jabra mic, remote hears English via meeting app

VF-INCOMING.NAME: IncomingTranslationENtoRU
VF-INCOMING.scenario: Remote speaks English, captured via CABLE Output, user hears Russian

VF-FALLBACK-STT.NAME: STTFallback
VF-FALLBACK-STT.scenario: Deepgram WS drops (error 10054), pipeline falls back to Whisper
VF-FALLBACK-STT.expected-outcome: After 3 Deepgram drops, UnifiedSttSession switches to Whisper
VF-FALLBACK-STT.failure-expected: Deepgram WS drops every ~20-25s on unstable networks

VF-FALLBACK-TRANSLATION.NAME: TranslationFallback
VF-FALLBACK-TRANSLATION.scenario: Groq fails, falls back to LiteLLM, then Yandex

VF-AUDIO.NAME: AudioCaptureStability
VF-AUDIO.scenario: Both pipelines capture audio without WASAPI errors
VF-AUDIO.expected-outcome: CAPTURE batches with speech-level rms (>0.05) on outgoing pipeline
VF-AUDIO.failure-expected: 0x800706CC when WASAPI COM held by list_devices()

VF-CONFIG.NAME: SettingsPersistence
VF-CONFIG.scenario: User changes device/API settings in Flask UI, pipeline restarts with new config
VF-CONFIG.expected-outcome: settings.json updated, Elixir passes env vars to Rust, pipelines use new config

VF-RAW-RMS.NAME: RawRmsNoiseFilter
VF-RAW-RMS.scenario: Whisper STT receives background noise (raw_rms < 0.015) and must NOT produce hallucinated transcripts
VF-RAW-RMS.expected-outcome: Avg raw_rms across buffer is computed from pre-gain values; if below 0.015, poll_transcript returns None without invoking Python/Whisper

required-signals.log-marker: Capture chunk #N (... rms_raw=0.0000XX) — raw RMS logged in deepgram_debug.log
required-signals.marker: No [STT] WHISPER log entries when raw_rms < 0.015

test-evidence.evidence: deepgram_debug.log shows rms_raw=0.000052-0.000060 for ambient noise chunks
pipeline_trace.log shows no WHISPER/TRANSCRIPT entries during quiet periods
cargo check passes with raw_rms field in AudioChunk and WhisperSttSession

VF-RAW-RMS.failure-expected: If adaptive gain boosts noise to amplified RMS 0.25, old code would trigger Whisper; new raw_rms filter prevents this

VF-WINDOW-HIDE.NAME: WhisperWindowHide
VF-WINDOW-HIDE.scenario: Whisper STT launches Python subprocess for transcription — must not create visible console windows
VF-WINDOW-HIDE.expected-outcome: python.exe used with creation_flags(0x08000000) CREATE_NO_WINDOW; no window flash observed during Whisper invocation

required-signals.marker: No python.exe or pythonw.exe MainWindowTitle visible during STT processing
[STT] WHISPER stt=Nms lang=... text='...' — Whisper produces output without window

test-evidence.evidence: Get-Process -Name "python*" returns no entries with MainWindowTitle during pipeline operation
whisper_stt.rs:109 contains cmd.creation_flags(0x08000000) with python.exe path
WAV files created in TEMP confirm Whisper subprocess was invoked

scenarios.scenario-1: Both pipelines start: outgoing captures from mic, incoming captures from CABLE Output
scenarios.scenario-3: 0x800706CC blocks AudioCapture creation — WASAPI COM held by list_devices()
scenarios.scenario-4: TTS preload timeout after 30s — ONNX model file missing or corrupted

scenarios.scenario-1: Deepgram WS connects (status=101) and produces FINAL transcript
scenarios.scenario-2: Whisper STT produces transcript after Deepgram drops 3 times
scenarios.scenario-3: Deepgram WS drops every ~20-25s (error 10054) — network issue
scenarios.scenario-4: Whisper hallucinates on short/noisy audio — model quality issue
scenarios.scenario-5: Whisper filters background noise: avg_raw_rms < 0.015 causes poll_transcript to return None. Evidence: rms_raw=0.000052-0.000060 in deepgram_debug.log, no WHISPER entries in pipeline_trace.log
scenarios.scenario-6: Whisper passes speech: avg_raw_rms >= 0.015 triggers Whisper invocation. Evidence: rms_raw=0.05-0.07, WAV files created in TEMP, python.exe launched with CREATE_NO_WINDOW
scenarios.scenario-7: Whisper subprocess uses python.exe + CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000) — no visible window. Evidence: Get-Process shows no python MainWindowTitle
scenarios.scenario-8: Whisper 2-second buffer dilutes brief speech with surrounding silence. WAV files are 99.6% silence (250 non-zero bytes out of 64000). Whisper receives mostly silence and produces empty text. Root cause: buffer accumulates all audio for BUFFER_SECS=2.0, not just speech segments. Fix: reduce buffer to 1s or add VAD-based segmentation.

required-log-markers.marker: Capture chunk #N (... rms_raw=...) — raw_rms logged in deepgram_debug.log

scenarios.scenario-2: Yandex translates as fallback when Groq fails
scenarios.scenario-4: TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT 12001ms — Yandex API slow or unreachable

scenarios.scenario-2: Piper TTS produces audio for Russian text (incoming)
scenarios.scenario-3: TTS preload timeout — ONNX model file missing

scenarios.scenario-6: Loopback AudioChunk.raw_rms equals loopback signal RMS (loopback.rs:178). Evidence: loopback pipeline shows rms=0.000000 for inactive CABLE Output

required-log-markers.marker: Capture chunk #N (... samples, first=..., rms_raw=...) — raw_rms in deepgram_debug.log

gaps.gap: Whisper 2-second buffer dilutes brief speech with silence (scenario-8). Not a safety issue but reduces transcription accuracy for short utterances.
No automated unit tests — verification relies on runtime trace analysis and manual testing.

AutonomyAssessment.recommendation: Module is safe for autonomous execution. Buffer dilution is a known limitation, not a blocker.
